purpose: QA512 (Codex QA of release 512, 16 Oct 2026): the semantic validity of every numeric or coded cell the OFP table readers promote into a plan - the FLT PLANNING ALTN SUMMARY rows, the EDTO ENROUTE ALTN AIRPORTS rows and the FUEL ENROUTE AIRPORT station rows. A row whose cell breaks a rule keeps its airport (when readable) and its printed text, is held unread naming the invalid field, and publishes no value; no value is chosen or inferred. One file, byte-identical in the app (table-cell-rules.json) and ODSS (app/odss/table_cell_rules.json); both runtimes run tests/fixtures/table-cell-vectors.json against it.

text.short: a cell is printed in ASCII; a full-width, Arabic-Indic or zero-width character is not read
text.rule: QA516 (Codex QA of release 516, local observation): Python's \d and int() read any script's decimal digits and JavaScript's \d reads only 0-9, so a cell printed in full-width or Arabic-Indic digits was read by ODSS and held by the app. Both runtimes now read a table cell as printed and only in ASCII: a digit is 0-9, nothing is normalised or transliterated, and a cell holding any other character (a full-width or another script's digit, a zero-width space, a soft hyphen) is not valid - its row is held, fail-closed. The NOTAM timing rules deliberately normalise instead (NFKC, Cf dropped): there, recognising a clock is the conservative direction, because an unrecognised clock reads as no schedule; here, recognising a cell publishes its value.

icao.rule: an ICAO location indicator is four letters A-Z (ICAO Doc 7910)

iata.rule: an IATA airport code is three letters A-Z

runway.rule: a runway designator is a two-digit number 01-36 (the magnetic azimuth to the nearest 10 degrees), with L, C or R for parallel runways (FAA AIM 2-3-3); 00 and numbers above 36 do not exist

clock.rule: a UTC clock HHMM has HH 00-23 and MM 00-59; the EDTO checked period prints 0000-2359 (2400 does not occur in the format)

duration.rule: a flight time HHMM has MM 00-59 and lies between 1 minute and 10 hours (the 30 held originals print 0016-0332)

distance_nm.rule: a destination-alternate distance lies between 1 and 3000 NM (the 30 held originals print 65-1491)

flight_level.rule: a planned flight level lies between FL010 and FL510 (the 30 held originals print FL060-FL370)

wind_component_kt.rule: a wind component is M (head) or P (tail) and 000-250 kt (the 30 held originals print M000-P080)

fuel_kg.rule: a planned alternate fuel lies between 1 and 99999 kg (the 30 held originals print 1763-18913)

minima.rule: minima print a height or altitude in feet (0-20000 FT), a visibility or RVR in metres (0-10000 M), or both (the 30 held originals print 200-3000 FT and 0-7000 M)
